Mask Oxygen Sensor

Low-temperature VF oxygen sensor for pilot oxygen masks

A low-temperature variable-frequency oxygen sensor for fighter-pilot oxygen masks has been successfully prototyped with excellent performance metrics.

Advantages

  • Low-temperature VF oxygen sensor for aviation masks
  • O₂ partial pressure range 0.5–101 kPa
  • Response time t90 <15 s; warm-up 65 s
  • Package shell temperature <60 °C
